topic.title: Risk-to-Reward: What It Actually Tells You

research.summary: Risk-to-reward compares a planned loss with a planned target. It can help traders think in terms of potential payoff versus exposure, but it says nothing about whether price will reach the target. A high ratio does not rescue a weak setup. Use it as one part of a broader risk framework, not as a shortcut to confidence.
